conditions.C3: archived selected candidates from 400 known-family and 100 held-out jump worlds
conditions.C_rand: archived selected candidates from the same 500 jump worlds
conditions.DeepSeek_grammar: reconstructed selected candidates from the frozen 96-world grammar-constrained sensitivity

objective: Quantify whether archived validated escapes survive removal of motif semantics, removal of one motif at a time, or canonical field rebinding that ignores node roles and intervention-key changes.

policy_definitions.aligned: Replay the archived candidate with the historical motif-to-basis realizer.
policy_definitions.mask_signature: For candidates detected as the named signature, replace the realized expression with the exact incumbent expression while preserving the candidate representation; leave all other signatures aligned.
policy_definitions.motif_disabled: Replace every non-incumbent motif realization with the exact incumbent expression while preserving the archived candidate representation.
policy_definitions.role_action_blind_binding: Retain the detected motif's algebraic term shapes but rebind variables by public field type and lexical order, without node roles or intervention-key inspection; refit coefficients from public observations.

prohibited_interpretations: This post-hoc audit is a replacement confirmatory experiment.
Failure under a masked realizer proves that a model did not conceptualize the representation.
Success under role-blind binding establishes external scientific generalization.
Candidate rows are independent statistical replicates.
reporting: paired world transitions from aligned to each counterfactual policy
candidate gate attrition with explicit denominators
selection: All candidate representations and slots remain exactly as archived. Interventions are reselected deterministically from public action queries using counterfactual predictions before hidden outcomes are evaluated.
